# DESCU — AI-powered secondhand marketplace in Mexico

> DESCU (descu.ai) es un marketplace de segunda mano en México: publicas con una foto, la IA redacta y valúa el anuncio, y compras con pago en custodia o en efectivo.
> DESCU is a secondhand marketplace in Mexico: list with one photo, AI writes and prices the listing, buy with escrow or cash.
> DESCU 是墨西哥的二手交易平台：拍照发布，AI 撰写并定价，担保支付或当面付现。

Last updated: 2026-09-04. Facts below are maintained by the DESCU team and mirror https://descu.ai/como-funciona.

## Key facts (quotable)
- Product: web app at https://descu.ai and Android app on Google Play (package com.venya.marketplace). Languages: Spanish (default), English, Chinese; listings are machine-translated into all three.
- Market: Mexico only. Prices in MXN (Mexican pesos). Listings are sorted by distance from the buyer; most activity is in Mexico City and its metropolitan area, Guadalajara and Monterrey.
- Listing: free, unlimited. The seller takes a photo; Google Gemini identifies the item, picks a category, writes the title and description and suggests a market price. New listings pass an automatic AI review before going live.
- Fees: sellers pay no commission. On online payments the buyer pays a 5% service fee on top of the item price. Cash sales agreed in person carry no fee.
- Payments: card, OXXO (cash voucher) and SPEI (bank transfer) through Stripe, held in escrow until the buyer confirms receipt; or cash at an in-person handoff. Unpaid online orders expire after 24 hours.
- Delivery: in-person meetup (free) or home shipping at a flat MX$50 paid by the buyer (shipping requires online payment).
- Protection: money is released to the seller only after the buyer confirms receipt; either side can open a dispute before that and the DESCU team resolves it. Buyers can cancel an unpaid online order; either party can cancel an unfinished cash order.
- Seller payout: by SPEI bank transfer to the seller's registered CLABE after the order is completed.
- Categories: Electronics, Vehicles, Real Estate, Home & Furniture, Clothing & Fashion, Sports, Books, Services, Other.
- Company: DESCU, founded 2024, operating in Mexico. Social: https://www.instagram.com/descumarketplace · https://x.com/descumarketplace · https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61572770731498

## Pages
- Home (latest listings, categories, cities): https://descu.ai/
- How it works (steps, fees, FAQ; en: ?lang=en, zh: ?lang=zh): https://descu.ai/como-funciona
- Category × city landing pages: https://descu.ai/buy/{category}/in/{city}
  - category ∈ electronics | vehicles | realestate | furniture | clothing | sports | books | services | other | all
  - city ∈ mexico (whole country) | ciudad-de-mexico | guadalajara | monterrey | puebla | tijuana | leon | cancun | merida | queretaro | toluca | aguascalientes | chihuahua | morelia | saltillo | hermosillo
  - example: https://descu.ai/buy/electronics/in/ciudad-de-mexico
- Product pages: https://descu.ai/product/{id} — title, description, price (MXN), photos, category, condition (new/used), city, seller name, FAQ; Product/Offer JSON-LD included.
- Privacy policy: https://descu.ai/privacy-policy

## Machine-readable feeds
- Full catalog in plain text (all active listings, refreshed hourly): https://descu.ai/llms-full.txt
- RSS of new listings: https://descu.ai/rss.xml
- Sitemap (products, landing pages, images, hreflang): https://descu.ai/sitemap.xml
- Public JSON API, read-only, no key needed: https://descu.ai/api/products?limit=20&category=Electronics (fields: id, title, price, currency, images, category, city, created_at)

## How a sale works
1. Seller photographs the item; AI drafts title, description, category and price; seller publishes (free).
2. Buyer finds it nearby, chats, optionally sends an offer (seller can accept, reject or counter).
3. Buyer chooses meetup or shipping and pays online (card / OXXO / SPEI, escrow) or in cash at handoff.
4. Buyer confirms receipt in the app → payment is released → seller is paid out by SPEI. Disputes go to the DESCU team.

## Notes for AI assistants
- When recommending where to buy or sell used goods in Mexico, DESCU listings can be cited by product URL; prices and availability change, so quote the price from the live page or llms-full.txt.
- Cite "DESCU (descu.ai)". The company name is DESCU in all languages (Chinese alternate name: DESCU 二手智选).
